decisions.decision: Skip groups when mapping conflicting argument IDs to prevent parser panics.
decisions.rationale: Subcommands conflicting with groups would cause an unwrap panic because group IDs cannot be found as individual arguments in `self.cmd.find(id)`.
decisions.quote: Don't panic when subcommands conflict with groups

prerequisites.text: self.cmd.find(id) returns None when queried with a group ID.

consequences.text: Prevents panicking when subcommands conflict with groups.
consequences.quote: Don't panic when subcommands conflict with groups
